preconditions.description: The input s is a string.
The input string s contains only lowercase letters or is empty.

postconditions.expression: return_value == all(ord(s[i]) <= ord(s[i+1]) for i in range(len(s)-1))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if the characters in s are in non-decreasing alphabetical order, and False otherwise.
